copay.eligibility: For eligible patients with commercial prescription insurance. Government-insured patients cannot use this co-pay card. Program limits and plan requirements apply.

assistance.name: Amgen Safety Net Foundation
assistance.text: Financial-need and coverage requirements apply. Use the foundation’s eligibility criteria to check your situation; assistance is not guaranteed.

cash.name: AmgenNow
cash.text: Amgen offers a separate cash-pay route. Check its current price and terms, then compare with your insurance cost.

about.text: Repatha is an injectable prescription medicine used to lower LDL cholesterol and, for certain adults, reduce the risk of major cardiovascular events. Your prescriber can explain whether it is appropriate for you.
